messages:
Emily Chen: Opening a PR to clarify split-DNS + resolver fallback behavior for Private-Lite installs (edge colocation). Need a small CoreDNS example, a brief migration note for 1.3 -> 1.4, and a couple of test steps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :eyes:

docs-bot: PR created by Emily Chen: redwood-inference/docs #1234 - `split-dns: resolver fallback & migration` (CI queued)

Raj Patel: Nice — can we show conditional forwarding for the KMS/HSM domain and an upstream DoT provider? A tiny CoreDNS config will help customers replicate. Also call out ordering: local stub -> internal forwarders -> DoT upstream.

Max Torres: Add quick test commands in the doc too. I usually ask users to run:
```
# verify coreDNS is answering
dig +short @127.0.0.1 -p 1053 kms.internal A
# check TLS endpoint using curl with host override
curl -v --resolve "api.private:443:10.0.0.10" https://api.private/health
```
Also note: if systemd-resolved is present, mention `nftables`/iptables DNAT for port 53 or using the stub resolver port.

Olivia Nguyen: We should add a migration snippet for customers on older installers (<=1.3) who added /etc/hosts hacks. Something like: undo host entries, enable the local stub listener, then apply the new CoreDNS forward config. Link to migration script in infra repo would be helpful.

Raj Patel: One more wording nit: prefer `Private (light footprint)` in user-facing docs rather than `Private-Lite`. And add a short bullet about NXDOMAIN handling for kms.internal (don't cache negative responses aggressively).

Emily Chen: Thanks — I'll update the PR with the CoreDNS snippet and test steps. Dropping the example CoreDNS block here so it’s easy to copy into the docs: feel free to propose tweaks. If someone from infra can spin this up in staging, ping me.

Emily Chen: ```
.:1053 {
    forward . 1.1.1.1 1.0.0.1 tls_servername=cloud-dns.example.com
    forward kms.internal 10.0.0.20 10.0.0.21
    cache {
        success 3600
        denial 60
    }
    log
}
```

Max Torres: Looks good. For the `forward` to DoT upstream we might need the `tls` plugin stanza depending on CoreDNS version — add a note about CoreDNS >=1.10 required for `tls_servername` flag.

Olivia Nguyen: I'll test this afternoon in the staging edge cluster and post results here. Will try both the hostfile -> stub migration and the fresh install.

docs-bot: CI passed for #1234 — spelling checks and link validation OK.

Max Torres: Quick UX suggestion: add a one-line troubleshooting checklist in the doc header: `1) verify local resolver, 2) verify internal forwarders, 3) test DoT upstream, 4) remove host overrides` — keeps support tickets shorter.

Emily Chen: Merged after Olivia confirmed staging tests. Thanks all! I'll follow up with a short release note about the migration behavior and link to the installer flag `--use-stub-resolver`.
